visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Starting with No Subsets at All
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list of subsets of 1, 2, 3 should have 8 entries, but the program prints an empty list.

solution.explanation: The empty set is itself a subset, so the result must start with one entry, an empty array. Starting with an empty list of subsets leaves nothing to extend.
